Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.  Teaching was going on at Oxford by 1096, and it grew quickly after 1167, when Henry II banned English students from attending the University of Paris. The Aztecs founded their capital, Tenochtitlan, in 1325, more than two centuries later.

The earliest sharks appeared roughly 450 million years ago, while the first true trees (like Archaeopteris) didn’t show up until around 385 million years ago. That means sharks were cruising the oceans for something like 60 million years before there was a single forest on land.
